name: better-writing
description: >- UX writing and interface copy. Use when writing or reviewing any user-facing text. Triggers on UX writing, microcopy, button labels, link text, error messages, empty states, placeholder text, settings labels, capitalization, sentence case, voice and tone.
author: jakubkrehel
summary_zh: 用于撰写和审核界面文案，帮助优化按钮、提示、报错等用户可见文字的清晰度与语气。
